# Soumil Datta

> Ph.D. student at the Kahlert School of Computing, University of Utah, researching machine learning security: adversarial attacks and defenses for LLMs, VLMs, and diffusion models, and the robustness of learning-based robotic systems. Jointly advised by Daniel Brown (ARIA Lab) and Guanhong Tao (SaLT Lab).

## Pages
- [Home: research, publications, news, awards, service](https://soumildatta.github.io/): overview of research areas and full publication list
- [CV](https://soumildatta.github.io/cv/): education, research and teaching experience, awards
- [Teaching](https://soumildatta.github.io/teaching/): teaching assistant history at the University of Utah and University of Mississippi

## Research areas
- Securing generative models: prompt injection defense, model IP protection, adversarial manipulation of LLMs/VLMs/diffusion models
- Robust robot learning: dataset poisoning in behavioral cloning, vulnerabilities of learning-based control
- Adversarial perception: loss-function-based attacks on object detection models
